name: nomina
description: Read-only markets research from public data: on-chain Chainlink prices (crypto, FX, gold, SPY/QQQ/NVDA), US Treasury yields, BLS macro series, SEC filings, GDELT headlines. No API key, no account, no trading.
long_description:
Nomina gives Claude source-backed answers to market questions using data that anyone may read and redistribute: Chainlink price feeds read directly from the Ethereum blockchain (Bitcoin, Ether, Solana and other crypto, EUR/USD and other FX, gold and silver, and a small set of US equities and ETFs such as SPY, QQQ, NVDA and TSLA), the US Treasury's daily par yield curve, Bureau of Labor Statistics series (CPI, unemployment, payrolls, earnings), SEC EDGAR company filings, and GDELT news records.

Five read-only tools. search_markets finds symbols in Nomina's catalog and recent headlines. research_asset returns the latest value, period change, drawdown and volatility, dated history, and headlines for one symbol, over a named period or an exact date window. compare_assets aligns 2–6 symbols on shared dates, each in its own unit. market_overview reports period changes for BTC, ETH, SOL, gold, SPY, QQQ, EUR/USD, US 2- and 10-year yields and CPI. company_fundamentals returns the latest annual and quarterly revenue, income, EPS, balance-sheet and cash-flow figures with filing links for an SEC registrant. Every response carries source URLs, observation timestamps, and caveats.

Limits: individual stock prices are available only for the equities that have on-chain feeds; use company_fundamentals for filings data on other companies. Oracle prices are aggregates that update on heartbeat or deviation and can lag exchange closes; on-chain history starts when a feed launched. Headlines are GDELT records (title and link), not article text, and GDELT may throttle. Only your search terms, symbols, tickers, and requested period or date window are sent to these public sources — Nomina stores no conversations or queries. Requires a Claude Desktop release with MCPB v0.4 UV-runtime support and internet access for the first install and for queries.
